notices.title: Steam Week in Review: Here are the 32 Steam games brave enough to release on GTA 6 day
notices.contentSnippet: All the interesting Steam facts for the week ending August 16.

notices.title: ZZZ Sigrid Release Time (All Servers)
notices.contentSnippet: Pull for Sigrid on her release date in Zenless Zone Zero, or opt for the rerun of Dialyn, Yuzuha, and Harumasa instead.

notices.title: NTE 1.3 Release Time & Countdown (Neverness to Everness)
notices.contentSnippet: Zankou and Linko are the two characters who will debut in Neverness to Everness version 1.3.

notices.title: First Look at 2 New WWE 2K26 WrestleMania 42 DLC Wrestlers
notices.contentSnippet: WWE 2K26 gives fans a first look at a pair of popular wrestlers being added to the game as part of the new WrestleMania 42 DLC pack.

notices.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave is Officially Leaving Millions of Players Behind Next Month
notices.contentSnippet: With Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave launching next month, millions of players are about to be unable to play the game at release.

notices.title: Near-Perfect PS2 FPS Games No One Played
notices.contentSnippet: The PlayStation 2 wasn't known for its first-person shooters, which might explain why these great FPS games slipped through the cracks.

notices.title: Gamers Can Win Up to $13,900 By Helping Out Popular Open-World RPG
notices.contentSnippet: A popular open-world RPG gives players a chance to win thousands in cash by creating new mods, ships, and battle scenes for its latest expansion.

notices.title: League of Legends YouTuber unearths the original investor pitch from when the game was called Onslaught: War of the Immortals
notices.contentSnippet: Back when the game was seemingly 6v6, Sion had a beard, and the story revolved around "an antichrist of sorts."

notices.title: David Brevik, creator of Diablo, reveals the 'worst ending' to any game he's played:  'But I really love the game. It's amazing'
notices.contentSnippet: The legendary game designer guides us through the games on his PC.

notices.title: Where's the weirdest place you've heard videogame music?
notices.contentSnippet: Why does hearing it in public places feel so… wrong?

notices.title: Iron Nest is the best 'Battleship' game I've played in years—and it doesn't even have boats
notices.contentSnippet: Use your smarts to locate enemies and meticulously plot firing solutions.

notices.title: The Quake community simply cannot stop delivering, having just released a 22-map 'Deathmatch Jam' to celebrate the shooter's 30th birthday
notices.contentSnippet: Frag your friends to mark three decades of Quake.
